text: Urban observation shows a lack of consideration for everyday street life. This is shown
through the little to no public space, mainly there for show rather than an actual social
environment. This is unlike real Cario where street life is always busy. Similar to the
architect’s focus on developer led designs that prioritize image and efficiency over spatial
logic and culture. The New Administrative Capital is a core example of Koolhaas’s Generic
City, identity there is replaced by bigger and modern designs while their architecture

Zamalek and West El Balad are historical areas of Cairo, loved by their depth of
